name: browser-use
headline: CraftDesk - Package Manager for Claude Code
short_description: CraftDesk is a package manager for Claude Code skills, agents, and other AI resources. It enables developers to install, manage, and version control AI capabilities. It integrates with Claude Code and supports dependency management for AI workflows.
author: mensfeld

sections.overview:
CraftDesk is a command-line package manager designed for managing AI capabilities in Claude Code and other AI development environments. It provides dependency management, version control, and multi-agent synchronization for skills, agents, commands, hooks, plugins, and collections—similar to npm for Node.js or Bundler for Ruby. With CraftDesk, developers can install crafts from Git repositories with automatic recursive dependency resolution, lock versions for reproducible environments across teams, and manage collections of related AI capabilities. The tool supports monorepos with subdirectory extraction, auto-converts GitHub URLs, and integrates directly with Claude Code settings. A self-hosted registry server is in development to enable private registries and centralized craft distribution.
Installing and managing reusable Claude Code skills and agents across teams
Version-controlling AI capabilities for reproducible development environments
Sharing collections of related crafts that work together
Managing dependencies for AI-powered development tools
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mensfeld/craftdesk`

```bash
craftdesk install solar-panel-optimization
craftdesk install wind-turbine-maintenance-predictor
craftdesk install energy-grid-load-balancer
```
